model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of personnel within a specific organization, displaying the proportions of employees categorized by their respective roles. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different category: “体育” (sports) is represented by a dark blue slice, accounting for approximately 21%; “社会” (social work) is depicted in a dark teal color and represents roughly 14%; “商务” (business) is shown in a light blue color and constitutes approximately 19%; “政府” (government) is represented by a yellow slice, estimated to be around 20%; “文化” (culture) is displayed in a light green slice, accounting for approximately 6%; “经济” (economy) is shown in a dark purple slice, representing approximately 14%; and “科学” (science) and “环境保护” (environmental protection) are combined in a dark gray slice, estimated to be around 2%. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and a legend is present, identifying each slice’s corresponding category and color. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
